When facilities are at 60%, a ceasefire is in effect, and institutions are operating normally, 8 existing public workstations will prioritize making repair parts by hand: every 60 seconds, expend 12 iron, 4 tools, and 4 knowledge to produce 2 parts, with a stock limit of 24. Regular production resumes automatically once facilities are fully repaired.

Requires 12 knowledge. Loaded cargo orders, recorded debts, and existing treaty obligations will still be honored; basic welfare in each district reverts to local responsibility.
Propose a National Compact Amendment

Requires 60 food and 180 knowledge; submitted for public deliberation after 600 seconds. Local autonomy requires more public recordkeeping; central coordination must also protect citizenship. Choosing “Public Industry First” assigns more existing workstations and raw materials to public manufacturing; choosing “Shared Welfare Responsibility” reduces the scale of public production.

Requires 48 food, 12 medicine, 8 parts, and 20 knowledge; assigns 32 border guards for 180 seconds. The technological gap in deployed equipment directly affects combat losses. The operation targets external threats and will not affect the citizenship of local mutant residents; clearing the threats secures the waterways for 1200 seconds.

Your nation contributes 300 grain, 120 tools, and 240 knowledge; the other party contributes 240 grain, 80 tools, and 120 knowledge. Requires your nation to guarantee equal citizenship and local autonomy, with active trade between both parties and stable local public services. Any overdue debt must first be settled with export goods on hand. Accession will not move population or cancel old debts; afterward, the other party will regularly deliver its share to the public warehouse.

Costs 80 knowledge and 8 tools; bilateral relations will suffer greatly. Cargo already in transit will still be delivered. The other party will also reassess its reliance on our raw materials and its debts and claims.

Costs 180 food, 30 medicine, 40 tools, 40 parts, 40 steel, and 80 knowledge; a dispute notice must be issued before opening fire, followed by a 300-second negotiation period. This will reduce our legitimacy by 10, and registered residents who take part will suffer real casualties. Border clashes cannot directly annex the other party's government.
